summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3-state dashboard + context-aware onboarding wizard overhaul (Findings A/B/C/E/F/G/H/I/K). All critical flows PASSED. STATE 1 (QA 221, snoozed): new-merchant-getting-started + gs-hero + gs-hero-feefree-chip ('Your first payment is fee-free') + gs-dashboard-preview render; fee-free-welcome-modal, fee-free-banner and kyc-required-banner are all suppressed. Per-track hero copy on /dashboard for creators correctly shows step 4 = 'Claim your @handle' and step 5 = 'Share your page'. Reachability guard redirects /get-started?step=share back to step=link (gs-step-handle) when the @handle artefact does not exist yet. Creator claim-handle wallet gate renders all required testids (gs-handle-wallet-note, gs-handle-go-payouts, gs-handle-claim='Claim & add payout address', gs-handle-open-editor='Open the full editor →'); subtitle no longer contains 'no other setup needed'. Typing a handle enables the primary CTA; clicking it with no wallet opens wallet-manager-modal (then triggers mandatory step-up verify dialog). Per-track eyebrow confirmed: 'Getting started · Creator' and 'Getting started · Developer' (visually verified via screenshot). Developer step-4='Your API key' and step-5='Make a test payment' labels render. Sticky step footer at 1280x720 has position:sticky; bottom:0 ancestor (gs-handle-claim visible at y=642 within 720 viewport). STATE 3 owner regression: dash2026-root + recent-payments-list render; no gs-hero / gs-setup-complete-strip. Mobile 390x844 state-1 and claim-handle both have zero horizontal overflow. STATE 2 (setup-complete strip) and full dark-mode spot shot not fully exercised: STATE 2 is unreachable without writes on the live DB, and the final dark-mode nav was interrupted by a Cloudflare 'Verify you are human' challenge after many rapid requests — reported but not blocking. QA 221 purpose_vertical reset to NULL; no writes left on prod (handle not claimed, wallet-manager modal cancelled).

integration_issues.flow: /dashboard initial visit without 'Do this later' snooze
integration_issues.issue: On first /dashboard load for QA 221, the page auto-redirects to /get-started?step=<next incomplete>, so State-1 (new-merchant-getting-started + gs-hero) is only observable AFTER the 24h 'do this later' snooze keys are set in localStorage (dyno_wizard_snooze_<cid> / dyno_do_this_later_<cid>). This is likely the intended Finding F 'resume where you left off' behaviour, but the review-request wording 'open /dashboard → MUST render new-merchant-getting-started' can be read as expecting state-1 on cold entry. Please confirm whether the auto-resume redirect is intentional for fresh-brand users; if yes, update the acceptance criteria. If not, state-1 should render on the dashboard until the user explicitly enters the wizard.

action_items: Confirm expected /dashboard behaviour on a fresh brand with no snooze set: should it render state-1 (hero + faded preview) or auto-redirect to /get-started? Current build redirects on first visit — state-1 only shows after snooze/'Do this later' is clicked.

STATE 2 (gs-setup-complete-strip) could not be reached on the live DB without writes; consider an E2E-only toggle (query param or dev flag) so testers can observe this state without seeding wallet/link/MFA rows.
critical_code_review_comments: WalletManagerModal correctly gates writes behind a step-up (security scope) verification — good defensive design. However the sequence 'click Claim & add payout address → wallet-manager-modal opens → immediate Verify-it's-you code dialog' is a 3-layer stack for an empty-wallet user; consider pre-flighting the step-up before opening the manager, or inlining the verify-OTP within the manager body to reduce modal-on-modal nesting.

Reachability guard correctly short-circuits step=share → step=link when the @handle artefact is missing. Suggest adding a visible banner/toast ('We moved you to step 4 because the previous step isn't done yet') so users understand the redirect instead of just appearing on a different step.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (10/11 scenarios fully validated; STATE 2 not reachable without writes, dark-mode final shot blocked by Cloudflare challenge)

test_credentials: QA 221 token saved to /tmp/qa221.txt; owner token saved to /tmp/owner.txt (both JWT, 30d).
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Temporarily toggled tbl_user.purpose_vertical for user 221 among creators/fundraisers/developers; RESET to NULL at the end (verified via SELECT).
context_for_next_testing_agent: QA 221 purpose_vertical is back to NULL on prod DB. The only non-default behaviour: /dashboard auto-redirects to the next-incomplete wizard step on fresh entry — use these localStorage keys to force state-1 rendering: dyno_wizard_snooze_231, dyno_do_this_later_231 (both set to Date.now()). To test per-track UI without hitting DB, also set localStorage.dyno_purpose_vertical='creators'|'fundraisers'|'developers'. The wallet-manager-modal data-testid is 'wallet-manager-modal' (and 'wallet-manager-x-btn' to close). STATE 2 remains unreachable without seeding wallet+link+MFA rows on company 231.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only one open question around intended /dashboard-vs-wizard redirect for fresh brands (noted above).
